hypotheses.justification: Nothing else in the statement needs this instance to elaborate. `IsGradedExtInternallyFinite` only needs `Field k`, `Linear k C` and `HasExt C`. In current Mathlib, `Functor.Linear` (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Linear/LinearFunctor.lean) does not take `[F.Additive]` as a parameter, so `[e.functor.Linear k]` still makes sense without it. The instance also follows from the remaining hypotheses: `Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products` (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Preadditive/AdditiveFunctor.lean) needs `[HasBinaryProducts C]`, which holds because C is abelian; `[PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete WalkingPair) e.functor]`, which every equivalence functor has; and `[e.functor.PreservesZeroMorphisms]`, given by the instance `preservesZeroMorphisms_of_full` because `e.functor` is full. So the proof starts with `have : e.functor.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _` and then runs unchanged through `gradedExtShiftSourceInverseEquiv`. No degenerate case matters, since the derivation works for every abelian C and every equivalence e.
